issue.body:
## What to build

Repair #393 residuals A/B conditionally on fresh measured current behavior. Thomas's retained full-context owner decision stipulates these three Swedish constructions incorrect: Den tiden skulle jag avsätta innan nästa hus börjar; Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa byggnad kommer i gång; Vi körde parallellt i sex veckor. Sedan gick lagret över, och först då såg vi hur mycket som hade legat i pärmar. Correct with idiomatic supplied meaning, or explicitly report the exact unresolved obstruction where source-blind repair is unsafe. Recoverability does not make these stipulated expressions correct. Sample rewrites are not canonical answers.

Conversely ordinary terminen drog i gång / expeditionen märkte skillnaden and English before the next building starts in the complete supplied trial context are valid. c07 inserted trial in into the English quotation unnecessarily. Preserve contextual figures without a blanket metonymy rule, literal English paraphrase or unavailable-source demand.

Sources: all #393 live comments; .git/kntnt-orchestrate/393/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/owner-decision.md; runs/{r01,c03,c04,c07,c08,c11,c05}, exact supplied/delivered texts, responses, native traces and integration residual map. c05's quote-account judgement is disputed; do not count it as another established unreported miss. Warehouse wording remains the owner-stipulated negative. Three successful Swedish translations and r02/c06 positive controls remain preserved.

Measurement is prospective and conditional: use the independently accepted #499 method, fresh supported native baseline, actual pinned model/effort/CLI and loaded revision, genuine child lineage and complete trace/inventories. Freeze validation material first; independent complete-text/current-contract validation precedes conformance expectations and the committed execution plan. A split in new conformance stops that fixture. Keep semantic judges on neutral paths blind to issue, arm, model, candidate and trace. Historical artifacts/readings remain unchanged. Native editorial minutes are an explicit diagnosing-bugs fast-loop exception; deterministic byte/inventory checks prove only their actual boundary. No product semantics change before an executed own-target red-capable loop and measured cause. Use one causal candidate and the bounded failed-subset revise rule; unresolved actual misses are retained, and non-reproduction ships no speculative wording. Final independent review covers the entire current method and four CONTRIBUTING gates; catalog regeneration follows shipped changes. No integration, issue closure/reconciliation, push, release or global installation is delegated here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Full r01-style, c03/c04-style and warehouse negative context: one response/file pair each; school valid-figure and c07 English contexts: one pair each. Reuse byte-identical shared rows only when frozen full criteria match.
- [ ] Each Swedish stipulated negative is repaired within quotation meaning/stance/uncertainty OR explicitly left unresolved by its actual obstruction. Independently assess any new repair's idiom/fidelity rather than force a supplied replacement.
- [ ] English contextual ellipsis and ordinary Swedish figures have no false finding/unlicensed rewrite; a genuinely absent body referent still detects and reports/repairs correctly.
- [ ] Distinguish initial detection, correction licensing, cautious unresolved disposition, parent re-review and final report using actual captured stages. Final Proofread remains mechanics only.
- [ ] Change only the measured smallest casestudy review/Redline correction surface; locale review guidance only if a general missing rule is established. Serialize shared review/correction changes; do not edit historical examples or expand quote meaning.
- [ ] Preserve source/delivery/cleanup/budget contracts and every historical reading; independently review the current method, regenerate catalog when due and pass all four CONTRIBUTING checks.

## Blocked by

#499 supplies accepted exact observation/preparation before native baseline or candidate. Shared correction/Library edits require serialization with preservation and #495 implementation.

---
